title: Deer wearing sunglasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- antlers -->
  <path d="M38 26 L33 14 L28 16" stroke="#c98b4a" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <path d="M33 20 L38 16" stroke="#c98b4a" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M62 26 L67 14 L72 16" stroke="#c98b4a" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <path d="M67 20 L62 16" stroke="#c98b4a" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx="26" cy="36" rx="9" ry="6" fill="#e0a95f" transform="rotate(-25 26 36)"/>
  <ellipse cx="26" cy="36" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#f6c9a0" transform="rotate(-25 26 36)"/>
  <ellipse cx="74" cy="36" rx="9" ry="6" fill="#e0a95f" transform="rotate(25 74 36)"/>
  <ellipse cx="74" cy="36" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#f6c9a0" transform="rotate(25 74 36)"/>

  <ellipse cx="50" cy="46" rx="24" ry="22" fill="#e0a95f"/>

  <rect x="29" y="38" width="19" height="13" rx="5" fill="#2b2b3a"/>
  <rect x="52" y="38" width="19" height="13" rx="5" fill="#2b2b3a"/>

  <path d="M71 42 L77 40" stroke="#2b2b3a" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <rect x="32" y="40" width="6" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#7fd8ff"/>
  <rect x="55" y="40" width="6" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#7fd8ff"/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="56" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#7a4a2a"/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d="M44 63 Q50 67 56 63" stroke="#b5763c" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
